components.note: 攵 (tap, hand with stick) — striking or acting on something: 放, 改, 政, 教; in 败 a blow breaking a cowry 贝 shell (valuable): ruin, defeat.
贝 (bèi) is a loose sound hint for bài.
纟 (thread, simplified 糸) — silk and cord: 红, 线, 组; 绍 first meant to connect, hence to introduce.
召 (zhào) gives a loose sound; same part in 招 zhāo, 照 zhào, 超 chāo.
食 (food, eat) — a lid over a bowl of food. As a left-hand radical it becomes 饣: 饭 meal, 饿 hungry, 饱 full, 饺 dumpling.
氵 (water radical, 三点水) — water and rivers: 河, 海, 湖; 洛 is the name of a river, now used for sound in foreign names.
各 (gè) gives the sound luò: same part in 路 lù, 落 luò and 络 luò.
木 (tree) — trees and wood: 松, 林, 树; 杉 is a fir tree.
彡 (shān) is the same sound; as a radical 彡 is hair strokes or decoration.
石 (stone) — rocks: 破, 研, 码; 矶 is a rocky reef or jetty.
几 (jī) sounds exactly like 矶; also in 机 jī and 肌 jī.
辶 (walk, 走之旁) — movement and roads: 过, 进, 送; 遗 is leaving something behind or losing it.
贵 (valuable) — what is precious is what you regret leaving behind or what is left to heirs.
忄 (heart, 竖心旁) — feelings: 怕, 情, 快; 憾 is regret.
感 (gǎn) is a near sound match for hàn; same part in 撼 hàn.
讠 (speech, simplified 言) — speech and talking: 说, 计, 谈; 设 is to set up or plan by instruction.
殳 (shū, hand holding a tool) is only a loose sound clue; also in 投 tóu and 股 gǔ.
贝 (cowry shell, money) — wealth and trade: 财, 费, 买, 货; 赢 is to win or gain a profit.
丽 (beautiful) — simplified 麗, which showed a deer 鹿 with antlers, a symbol of grace. Seen in 美丽.
土 (earth) — soil and land: 地, 场, 坏; 压 is earth pressed down under a cliff 厂.
氵 (water radical, 三点水) — water: 河, 海, 汤; 淘 is to rinse and sift in water.
匋 (táo) sounds exactly like 淘; same part in 陶 táo and 萄 táo.
氵 (water radical, 三点水) — water: 河, 海, 汤; 汰 is to rinse away what is useless.
太 (tài) sounds exactly like 汰; also in 态 tài.
厂 (cliff) — stone and cliffs: 厚 thick, 原 origin, 压 press; 厉 first meant a whetstone, hence sharp and severe.
禾 (grain) — crops: 秋 autumn, 种 plant, 秒 second; 私 was grain held for oneself.
厶 (sī) is the ancient form of 私 itself, meaning private; 公 gōng (public) is its opposite.
亻 (person radical, 单人旁) — people and what they do: 你, 他, 位; 伟 is a great person.
韦 (wéi) gives a close sound (wěi); same part in 围 wéi, 违 wéi, 纬 wěi.
田 (field) — traditional 奮 shows a bird 隹 spreading its wings 大 out of a field: bursting into effort.
见 (see) — seeing and vision: 看, 现, 视, 览; 观 is to watch. 又 only stands in for the old sound part 雚 (guàn).
人 (person) — three persons 人人人: a crowd. Also in 观众 audience, 大众 the public.
弓 (bow) — bows and tension: 张 stretch, 引 draw, 弯 bend; 弹 is to shoot or spring, and a bullet.
单 (dān) is a loose clue for dàn/tán; compare 禅 chán and 蝉 chán.
土 (earth) — ground and land: 地, 场, 块; trash is thrown onto the ground.
立 (lì) is only a loose sound hint for lā.
土 (earth) — ground and land: 地, 场, 块; trash is thrown onto the ground.
及 (jí) is a near sound match (jī); same part in 吸 xī, 级 jí, 极 jí.
口 (mouth) — three mouths: many goods and people speaking; hence products, quality, and to taste. Also in 品尝 and 作品.
氵 (water radical, 三点水) — water: 河, 深, 浅; 测 was measuring the depth of water.
则 (zé) is close to cè; same part in 侧 cè and 厕 cè.
彡 (hair strokes, decoration) — patterns and appearance: 形 shape, 影 shadow, 须 beard; 彩 is colorful decoration.
采 (cǎi) sounds exactly like 彩; also in 菜 cài and 踩 cǎi.
衣 (clothing) — clothes and wrapping: 装, 被, 衬; 袭 is to attack suddenly, an old sense of "cover over". 龙 is only a loose sound clue.
口 (mouth) — breath and speech: 吸, 叫, 喊; 呼 is to breathe out or call.
乎 (hū) sounds exactly like 呼.
口 (mouth) — breath and speech: 呼, 吃, 喝; 吸 is to breathe in.
及 (jí) is a loose sound hint for xī; same part in 级 jí and 极 jí.
走 (run, walk) — movement: 起 rise, 越 cross, 赶 hurry, 趣; 超 is to jump over, surpass.
召 (zhào) is a loose sound clue; same part in 招 zhāo, 绍 shào, 照 zhào.
纟 (thread, simplified 糸) — silk and cord: 红, 线, 给; 级 first meant the order of threads, then rank.
及 (jí) sounds exactly like 级; also 极 jí, 吸 xī.
鬼 (ghost) — spirits and the unseen: 魔 demon, 魅 charm, 魄 spirit; 魂 is the soul.
云 (yún) is a near sound match for hún.
石 (stone) — stones and hard things: 研, 码, 砖; 破 is to smash or break.
皮 (pí) is a loose sound clue; same series 坡 pō, 披 pī, 波 bō.
土 (earth) — soil and land: 地, 场, 块; 坏 first meant to collapse, as of a wall of earth.
不 (bù) is only a stand-in for the old sound part 褱 (huái); a loose clue for huài.
忄 (heart, 竖心旁) — feelings: 怕, 情, 快; 愉 is a happy heart.
俞 (yú) sounds exactly like 愉; also in 偷 tōu and 输 shū.
火 (fire) — fire and heat: 灯, 烧, 炸, 热; 爆 is to burst in flames.
暴 (bào) sounds exactly like 爆, and means violent.
火 (fire) — fire and heat: 灯, 烧, 爆; 炸 is to explode or to fry.
乍 (zhà) sounds exactly like 炸; also in 诈 zhà, 作 zuò, 昨 zuó.
辶 (walk, 走之旁) — movement and roads: 过, 进, 送; 迟 is slow going, late.
尺 (chǐ) is a close sound match, tone differs.
走 (walk, run) — a person with swinging arms above a foot 止. As a radical it marks movement: 起, 越, 超, 趣.
食 (food) — eating and meals: 饭, 饿, 饱 (as 饣); 餐 is a meal.
角 (horn, corner) — a picture of an animal horn. Read jiǎo for horn, corner and angle; jué for a role, as in 角色.
⻊ (foot, form of 足) — feet and travel: 跑, 跳, 跟; 路 is a road.
各 (gè) is a loose sound clue; same part in 洛 luò, 落 luò, 客 kè.
鬼 (ghost) — a creature with a big head and a hollow body. As a radical it brings in spirits: 魂 soul, 魔 demon, 愧 ashamed.
心 (heart) — feelings and will: 想, 思, 感; 志 is what the heart is set on, ambition.
士 (shì) is only a loose sound hint for zhì.
习 (practice) — simplified from 習, a young bird 羽 flapping its wings again and again to learn to fly.
